key_themes: Big Tech earnings bifurcation: AMZN/MSFT surge while AAPL disappoints on China and Services miss
AI infrastructure boom: AWS +37% and Azure +43% growth signal accelerating cloud spend
Platform monetization risk: Reddit and Roblox crater on Google AI search traffic disruption and engagement declines
Energy superprofits: ExxonMobil and Chevron report windfall Q2 earnings on Iran-conflict-driven oil price surge

stocks.discussion_driver: Amazon surged ~15% on July 31 after a massive Q2 earnings beat: AWS cloud revenue grew 37% YoY to $42.2B vs. the 31% consensus estimate, and total Q2 revenue reached $200.6B. This marks Amazon's largest single-day gain in over a decade, adding over $400B in market cap and pushing the stock to within 2.5% of its 52-week high.
bull_case: AWS revenue grew 37% YoY to $42.2B, significantly beating the 31% estimate and signaling accelerating market-share gains in enterprise cloud as AI workloads intensify
Advertising and third-party seller services also beat expectations, demonstrating broad-based strength across all major business segments and setting up full-year estimate upgrades
bear_case: After a 15% single-day surge, AMZN is trading just 2.5% below its 52-week high, creating near-term technical resistance and limited margin of safety for new buyers at this level
At 27x trailing earnings, any moderation in AWS growth momentum or macro softness in consumer spending could quickly compress the multiple and reverse recent gains

stocks.discussion_driver: Microsoft reported FY26 Q4 earnings after the close on July 29, triggering a ~15% single-day surge on July 30 — the largest single-day market-cap gain in stock market history. Azure grew 43% YoY (vs. 38% estimate), Microsoft 365 Copilot seats crossed 30M, FY26 Q4 revenue hit $90B (+18% YoY), and GAAP EPS of $4.81 rose 32% YoY — demonstrating that Microsoft's massive AI infrastructure investment is generating measurable returns.
bull_case: Azure's 43% YoY growth and 30M+ Copilot paid seats show AI monetization is accelerating, setting up multiple years of above-market cloud growth and enterprise software expansion
FY26 Q4 revenue of $90B and GAAP EPS of $4.81 (+32% YoY) crushed guidance on every key metric, suggesting conservative forward guidance that analysts will systematically raise through 2027
bear_case: Trading 16.8% below its 52-week high of $555.45, MSFT has significant ground to recover; at 25x earnings, growth must remain exceptional to justify the current premium valuation
Intense competition from AWS and Google Cloud could pressure Azure pricing and margins while massive AI capital expenditures continue to weigh on free cash flow generation

stocks.discussion_driver: Apple shares fell ~9.5% on July 31 — the stock's worst day since the pandemic selloff — after Q3 earnings disappointed on key metrics: Services revenue of $30.7B missed the $31.3B estimate, Greater China came in at $18.8B vs. $19.5B expected, and management guided for 9-11% revenue growth (vs. 12% consensus), citing severe DRAM/NAND supply constraints. This marks Tim Cook's final earnings call as CEO, adding leadership transition risk.
bull_case: Record Q3 revenue of $109.4B beat top-line estimates on iPhone and Mac strength; the upcoming product refresh cycle and AI-enhanced iPhone features could drive a new hardware upcycle in 2027
Services at $30.7B, despite missing estimates, represents a high-margin recurring revenue stream growing regardless of hardware cycles, providing durable earnings floor
bear_case: Supply chain disruptions (DRAM/NAND price inflation) and structurally weakening Greater China revenue create dual headwinds on the most critical iPhone revenue line, with near-term guidance well below consensus
CEO leadership transition away from Tim Cook introduces execution risk around Services acceleration and Apple Intelligence commercialization at a particularly critical strategic juncture

stocks.discussion_driver: Reddit plunged 22% on July 31 — its worst single-day decline since its 2024 IPO — despite a strong Q2 earnings beat (revenue $804.9M vs. $731.8M estimate, EPS $1.25 vs. $0.95 consensus, net income $253M doubling YoY). CEO Steve Huffman's warning that Google AI Overviews have made search referrals 'choppy,' combined with no new AI data-licensing deals announced and a slight U.S. DAU miss (53.2M vs. 54M), spooked investors fearing Reddit's search-dependent traffic model is structurally threatened.
bull_case: Revenue grew 61% YoY and net income more than doubled to $253M — fundamental execution is strong, and the selloff may represent a significant overreaction to a specific traffic-quality concern

At 51% below its 52-week high, the stock may be pricing in an existential AI threat that overstates the Google risk; Reddit's niche community content is difficult for AI summaries to replicate authentically
bear_case: Google AI Overviews directly threaten Reddit's most critical traffic source; if AI summaries eliminate the need to click through to Reddit, ad revenue per user and overall monetization collapses
No new AI data-licensing deals were announced, removing a key bull thesis for 2026 revenue diversification and raising questions about Reddit's competitive value in the AI training data market

stocks.discussion_driver: Roblox crashed ~27% on July 31 — its worst single-day loss ever — after Q2 earnings revealed only 8% bookings growth (vs. 70% YoY last year), DAUs declined to 123M from a 152M peak, and management withdrew full-year guidance entirely. BMO and Benchmark issued Sell ratings. The collapse of key engagement metrics and guidance removal has analysts questioning whether the platform has entered a structural lifecycle decline as its core users age out.
bull_case: Trading 76% below its 52-week high creates optionality for a recovery if international expansion (Southeast Asia, India) and new content categories can offset North American engagement declines
Roblox's unique position as a youth UGC entertainment platform gives it a loyal creator ecosystem that could be re-monetized through advertising, premium experiences, or AI-generated content tools
bear_case: DAUs fell from 152M peak to 123M and bookings growth collapsed from 70% to 8% YoY — this signals a structural engagement decline as users age out of the platform, not a temporary slowdown
Management withdrawing full-year guidance signals deep uncertainty about near-term trajectory; sell ratings from BMO and Benchmark indicate Wall Street confidence has fundamentally broken down
